item.text: {"category_edits":[{"category":"learning_objective","rationale":"Retain the existing weighted ranking loss and add 0.1 times the mean pairwise logistic loss over the same valid positive-negative pairs. This directly penalizes ranking reversals without changing sampling, architecture, inference, or training settings.","edits":[{"find":"    pairwise_loss = torch.nn.functional.softplus(valid_neg - valid_pos)\n    return (weights * pairwise_loss).sum()","replace":"    pairwise_loss = torch.nn.functional.softplus(valid_neg - valid_pos)\n    return (weights * pairwise_loss).sum() + 0.1 * pairwise_loss.mean()"}]}],"change_summary":"Add an unweighted pairwise logistic auxiliary term to the existing objective for all four category models; predictor changes are unnecessary."}
